name: Rest-Day Warrior
flavorText: You have an incredibly detailed training plan, several climbing YouTube channels memorized, and extremely strong opinions on periodization. Whether you actually do any of it is a separate question entirely.
superpower: Knowing exactly what they should train
villainLine: They'll throw themselves at the same move for two hours with zero plan. You find it exhausting to watch.
partnerLine: You bring the recovery plan, they bring the quietly terrifying ability — low effort, suspiciously high output.
